headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Hyderabad DEO orders inspection of graduate polling stations.
12 killed as truck crashes into shops near temple gate in MP’s Gwalior.
Keralam govt. to consider special rehabilitation package for P&T flats residents.
Sri Lanka’s Tamil parties seek sustained Indian push to realise spirit of Indo-Lanka Accord.
Protesters seek CEC’s resignation at Lehra Do Tiranga in Mumbai.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad DEO ne graduate polling stations ki jaanch ka hukam de diya.
MP ke Gwalior mein truck mandir ke qareeb dukano se takra gaya, 12 afraad jaan-ba-haq.
Keralam hukumat P&T flats ke makeenon ke liye makhsoos rehabilitation package par ghor kare gi.
Sri Lanka ki Tamil parties ne Indo-Lanka Accord par amal ke liye Bharat se musalsal madad mang li.
Mumbai ke Lehra Do Tiranga mein muzahireen ne CEC ke istefay ka mutalba kar diya.
